title: digitalis purpurea f. parviflora
intro: Digitalis purpurea f. parviflora, commonly known as Foxglove, is a biennial plant species known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Digitalis purpurea f. parviflora include its ability to treat heart conditions such as atrial fibrillation, congestive heart failure, and angina, by improving heart function and reducing symptoms. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its positive effect on the heart's electrical activity, increasing its contraction force and rate, while also exhibiting vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Digitalis purpurea f. parviflora include digoxin, digitoxin, and other glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
